messages:
Rachel (CS): Morning — saw a late-night spike in orchid's dedicated pool. Queue depth hit ~14 around 01:10 UTC and stayed elevated until ~03:30. Latency p99 up ~+180ms.
Leah (EngInfra): Dashboard: https://console.redwood/tenants/orchid/pools/orchid-dedicated/metrics
Leah (EngInfra): Quick 24h numbers:
```
24h_gpu_hours: 192.6
peak_1h_saturation: 94%
avg_queue_depth_1h: 11
p95_token_latency: 300ms
p99_token_latency: 480ms
24h_error_rate: 1.1%
```
Ashok (Ops): Autoscaler shows a blocked scale event at 01:12 (reason: pool_limit_reached). DeployBot also posted.
DeployBot: autoscaler: scale_event blocked for orchid-dedicated (reason: pool_limit_reached) :warning:
Sam (SRE): Any idea if this is many small interactive requests or a few long-running jobs? Queue depth of 11 could be backlogged batched work.
Rachel (CS): On call with the customer now — they ran a heavy evaluation/test job and then a burst of interactive traffic. They're currently at their 3-pool reservation cap.
Leah (EngInfra): Short fixes:
- enable transient burst: burst_capacity=2 (instant)
- manual scale: `rictl pool scale --tenant orchid --target_pools 4` (ops approval)
- prewarm caching for common prefixes and add auto-priority for small interactive requests
Ashok (Ops): Cost estimate for +1 pool for 12h: approx +$430. If they want 1h burst it's ~+$36.
Rachel (CS): I'll offer a one-time burst and a follow-up enablement to tune autoscale thresholds. I'll ask if they accept the +12h option.
Sam (SRE): Recommend new alert: queue_depth > 8 for 10m triggers runbook to check scale-blocks and traffic fingerprinting.
Maria (CSM): I'll set a 30m enablement tomorrow 10:00 PT and invite Leah + Ashok. Also will prepare a short ops playbook for customer.
Leah (EngInfra): Filed internal ticket RI-4821 to track the manual change and a follow-up postmortem. Tagging @Sam for runbook edits.
Sam (SRE): Will add runbook snippet and a quick evacuation play to shift interactive requests to cooler nodes.
Rachel (CS): Draft to customer: "We detected a transient queue spike overnight on your dedicated pool. We can provision temporary burst capacity to reduce latency immediately; estimate +$430 for 12h. We also recommend an enablement session to tune autoscale and caching. Proceed now?"
Rachel (CS): Waiting for Ops final go-ahead before executing. :thumbsup:
